evidence.paraphrase: An automobile arrives in a rural region where such machines have been essentially absent since a prior one was destroyed.
evidence.quote: I recognizes it as being an autymobile, the same of which ain\u2019t been in this country since the one belonging to Scenery Sims runs over some dynamite at Piperock and evaporates.

evidence.paraphrase: Calamity gives a rough operational account of how to run the gasoline-powered car.
evidence.quote: All yuh got to do is put gasoline in her, twist her tail a few times, pull the designated levers, and point her away from the stumps.

evidence.paraphrase: The narrator is instructed step by step on cranking and releasing the brake to start the automobile.
evidence.quote: All yuh got to do is to twist that front crank until she starts humming. Sabe? Then yuh get in and let this here brake loose.

evidence.paraphrase: An onlooker, Running Wolf, reacts with amazement at the sight of the automobile.
evidence.quote: He\u2019s got a look on his face that Columbus might a had when he first saw the shores of our fair country.

evidence.paraphrase: The narrator's horse reacts fearfully to the approaching automobile's noise.
evidence.quote: My bronc shows signs of nervousness, so I gets off.

evidence.paraphrase: The automobile's arrival stampeded and scattered all the town's horses, leaving people stranded.
evidence.quote: A autymobile invades our fair city today, and she swept us clean of hossflesh. Out on them racks is fifteen pieces of rope flopping in the breeze.

evidence.paraphrase: Mike contrasts the town's disorder with the arrival of 'civilization' brought by the automobile.
evidence.quote:
\u201cWhat\u2019s the matter with Paradise?\u201d I asks.

[p00184] \u201cCivilization,\u201d says Mike.

evidence.paraphrase: A large dynamite explosion destroys the jail and rains debris across the town.
evidence.quote: Comes a rumble and a shake, the town is lit up for a second, and then it begins to rain pieces of jail all over town. Thirty sticks of dynamite is some little dwelling-mover.

evidence.paraphrase: Mike explains the technical makeup of the dynamite-in-cans salute devices stored in the jail.
evidence.quote: He\u2019s got five ten-gallon kerosene cans full of water down there, and in each can is six sticks of dynamite, wrapped in canvas and covered with axle-grease.

evidence.paraphrase: Mike reacts with alarm upon realizing the explosion was dynamite.
evidence.quote: \u201cDynamite!\u201d yells Mike. \u201cThere\u2019s \u2014\u2014 to pay and no pitch hot!\u201d
